parameters: Are you hearing me, gods above?!\! Can you not read my heart and soul?!\! I'll gladly throw my bits and baubles to the ground and desire no more...\! I am cleansed, a new man!\! I will walk the path of righteousness!\! Why do you not grant this accursed world clemency?!\! Why must you take her away?!\! Could you instead cause a quake here, or a flood there,\| why must you see fit to let her die?!
Alright, Diana...\| Have it your way...\! Let's just sleep it off, eh?
There they are.\! The last two souls in the resistance.\! End them...
